summary: Partial revert of Marksman Update: W no longer doubles attack speed/cap; Q grants attack speed; W retuned.
E Frostbite base and chilled damage reduced so she must use her whole kit.
Passive star damage up, W bonus damage down, cost changed; E castable anytime out of combat.
W Miasma cast range reduced; E Twin Fang healing lowered to reopen early-game windows.
Attack damage growth raised to 3.5 from 2.5; struggling since 6.3 nerf.
E Masochism damage up, cooldown down; Grasp weakened after earlier early-damage nerf.
Dismounted damage penalty vs minions/monsters removed; R range and trail duration reduced.
Fixed bug preventing Flash during E Zenith Blade cast time.
Q Poison Trail ticks four times per second, same DPS; W duration bug fixed.
W Astral Infusion cooldown increased at early ranks to curb lane sustain.
Q Ambush bonus attack speed reduced at higher ranks (70% to 50% max).
R Phoenix Stance proc damage up; persistent burn lasts one fewer tick.
Fixed bug allowing basic attacks during W Headbutt animation.
Q2 and W1 no longer dash him directly on top of target.
Plants now count as pets for Rylai's Crystal Scepter slow.
Hotfix: Q Poison Trail excess damage and missing AP scaling vs Baron/Vilemaw fixed.
Passive crit slow stronger but decays faster; Q no longer fully resets attack; flurry damage down.
W cone bug fixed so it is dodgeable; compensated with lower cooldown, more range, shorter silence.
E Flame Chompers damage down, mana cost up; one chomper hit per cast.
Q reworked to stacking Well Fed buff; AD up; R slow ramps to 95%, no cast time.
Base health regen up; Q cooldown reduced; Worked Ground duration shortened after roaming nerfs.
Q/E AP ratios up; minion healing and E health ratio down to trim safety abused in competitive.
Usability: ghouls teleport with him, W casts at max range, E no longer marks minions.
Rift Herald now correctly disables passive after it ranks up at level 11.
E Devastating Charge basic attack can now critically strike.
No longer locked out of active items if he dies during R channel.
E Spinning Slash no longer damages allies in an edge case.
Q Tumble no longer moves across certain ledges.
Hotfix after release: health growth, magic resist, attack speed and attack speed growth increased.
Cougar Q/W/E cooldowns 5s to 6s; Primal Surge heal scales with missing health.
Fixed Q mana cost applying multiple times when spammed at four Focus stacks.
E True Grit resists per stack halved, cap doubled; dashing toward champions grants 2 stacks.
Passive grove health cost reduced; Daisy targeting AI improved; E indicator clarity.
R mana cost and debuff duration down, base damage up; execute thresholds reworked post-revert.
Reverts 6.19 fix; Q2/W1 again place him on top of target.
Q Alpha Strike recoded: many bugfixes, 0.25s minimum untargetability, vision of next bounce.
R now grants armor/MR instead of converting damage to AD; Q range stacks with R.
Well Fed bonus health per stack cut to 2% from 3%; 6.20 changes overshot.
E Elastic Slingshot shows landing warning 0.75s before impact.
R Maiden now pushes the lane she is summoned in.
E mines check collision every 0.1s instead of 0.25s so dashes trigger them.
Q Death Sentence no longer sends him to odd places through base gates.
R Glacial Fissure slow now applies consistently to enemies in fog of war.
Q3 can now dash over walls while under E Valor.
Hotfix: Q Overload no longer bounces to unmarked targets after hitting Flux target.

Q cooldown down with recast dash; Daisy health up and smarter.
Remount time halved; W fourth-hit max health damage reduced.
Q crits no longer travel faster than normal casts.
W no longer auto-fires in passive second shot's direction.
Fixed W Dark Passage being castable globally for vision.
Tentacles now swing at champions under Taric R or Kindred R.
Can no longer queue Q during R cast time (misleading rocket position).

Hotfix: Isolation on minions/pets, evolved W reveal, evolved Q cooldown refund restored.

W/E cooldowns down; R forms faster but half damage until formed; E bonus needs formed storm.

W reworked: 2 charges, cheaper, stronger voidlings that multiply less and die easier.
W no longer fires during Q travel; bug reverted despite acknowledged power-down.

Armor and health growth increased to help late-game scaling.
Reverts 6.20 W change; walks into range instead of casting at max range.
Clone kills now properly credit Shaco (e.g., Mejai's).

E damage no longer fires if Fizz dies while on his pole.
Blast Cone no longer launches him forward during E.

Ability update: third-hit passive, new W thrust, E attack speed, R blocks distant damage.
Unstoppable during Q descent; R bonus attack range increased.
Earlier attack speed nerfs reverted; lower base health; traps weaker; Headshot procs on turrets.
Big update: E cooldown up early, stronger autos, Q/W retuned; stated net power-down.
Hotfix: base movement speed, health, mana down; W cost up; update left her overtuned.

Attack range and health regen up; W cooldown reduced and scales with stacks.
Spell shield rework: E now blocks only the first of simultaneous abilities.
Spell shield rework: W now blocks only the first of simultaneous abilities.

E no longer goes on cooldown if Banshee's Veil breaks during flight.
Hotfix: fixed a bug where Jax caused games to crash.
Full visual and gameplay update released; no balance context given in notes.

Health regen up; Q first-shot bonus AD ratio increased.

W now max-health damage; E terrain collision more lenient; R headbutt cast time removed.
Passive damage up and scales earlier; shorter Devour lockouts on W and R.
Q can no longer both pop a spell shield and deal damage.
Hotfix: R could replace an ally's ultimate in specific circumstances.
Q damage reduced at later ranks; soldier damage reduced after level 5 post-update.

Base resists down; passive resists up late; shield timing standardized; E freeze damage halved.
